description: Offre transport en commun du réseau Transp'Or (GTFS) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Transp'Or - Pays de l'Or Agglomération. Elenco dei percorsi, degli orari e delle fermate della rete Transp'Or in formato GTFS: - Linea 1 Palavas les Flots- Carnon - Etang de l'Or (Perols) - Linea 2 Mauguio - Odisseo (Montpellier) - Linea 3 Saint-Aunès - Nd de Sablassou (Castelnau le Lez) - Linea 4 La Grande-Motte - Etang de l'Or (Perols) Linea ... Coverage: Transp'Or - Pays de l'Or Agglomération. The portal shows the English title as "Transp'Or Transit Offer (GTFS)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Transp'Or - Pays de l'Or Agglomération. Its keywords include mauguio-carnon, bus, la-grande-motte, palavas-les-flots, pays-de-lor. The listing shows 4 download or service links in GTFS. The listing shows 2026-05-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
